{{Quote|Han's paternal ancestry goes back to Berethron e Solo, who introduced democracy in the Corellian empire.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
A '''republic''' ruled by a [[Diktat]] replaced the [[Corellian empire]] as the political regime of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The regime remained in place more than 300 hundred years until the government of Diktat [[Daclif Gallamby]] collapsed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:Corellia_SOF.png|thumb|left|200px|The planet Corellia]]
The Corellian republic was officially a constitutional republic.<ref name="SoF" /> Although the regime was originally democratic,<ref name="TCoPL" /> it evolved over time to a corporatocracy led by the boards of directors of the most powerful Corellian corporations, including [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] and [[Gowix Computers]]. The elected [[Head of State/Legends|head of state]], the [[Diktat]], was the formal executive of Corellia and the governor of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] as well as the the [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|commander-in-chief]] of the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Armed Forces]]. However, the real power of the Diktat depended on the corporate powers managing the government, with some Diktats only serving as puppets on Corellia while other actively ruled the entire sector.<ref name="SoF" />

The government and the administration were based in the [[Governmental Sector]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Corellia.<ref name="SoF" /> The Diktat had their office in the [[Coronet Capitol]].<ref name="SWG:DG" />

==History==
The Corellian republic was created by the last [[King/Legends|king]] of Corellia, [[Berethron e Solo]], who dissolved the [[Corellian empire]]<ref name="SoF" /> in [[312 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" /> in order to introduce democracy on the planet.<ref name="TCoPL" />

At the time of the [[Declaration of a New Order]], when the Galactic Republic transitioned into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Corellian Diktat was [[Dupas Thomree]]. Thomree made an arrangement with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to maintain his regime and the independence of the Corellian sector.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Hence, the sector became an [[Imperial client state]].<ref name="SoF" /> Dupas Thomree accepted to support Imperial galactic policies, pay taxes to the Empire and maintain the activity of the [[CEC shipyards|Corellian shipyards]]<ref name="TFUCG" /> to produce Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The Corellian sector remained officially independent and the Diktat saved its government but he became a puppet ruler who only controlled the administration of the planet Corellia. The sector and its Corellian Defense Force were ''de facto'' placed under the authority of the newly-appointed [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Corellian sector.<ref name="SoF" /> Indeed, this situation led the independent-minded people of Corellia to protests vigorously against the Diktat.<ref name="TFUCG" /> Over time, Diktat Dupas Thomree distanced himself from his populations and increased restrictions on freedom. With the full support and protection of the Empire, the Diktat became an autocrat who could do whatever he wanted without any concern of the population protesting. Moreover, the position of Diktat became a lifetime appointment; with each Diktat selecting himself his successor.<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>

When the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] erupted between the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Diktat Dupas Thomree accepted to provide Corellian military forces to the Empire. Dupas Thomree died not long after and was replaced by his designated successor, [[Daclif Gallamby]], who was completely unknown to the public.<ref name="AaS" /> During Gallamby's rule, the Galactic Civil War intensified. As Corellian armed forces were repeatedly sent away to support the Empire against the Rebellion, [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] exploded in the Corellian sector and the local economy began to decline. After the Rebel victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Diktat and his government became paranoid<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> and got scared to be overthrown by the Rebellion or by their own population.<ref name="AaC" /> Eventually, the Corellian government enacted strict isolationist measures, restricting trade and traffic<ref name="CTD" /> throughout the entire sector. These measures caused the collapse of the Corellian economy.<ref name="AaC" />

[[File:Daclif_Gallamby.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Daclif Gallamby]], the last Diktat of Corellia]]
After the death of the Emperor at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Galactic Empire fragmented.<ref name="TEA" /> At first, the regime was strengthened by the massive arrival of Imperial officers and troops who sought to take refuge in the Corellian sector.<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> However, without the direct protection of the Emperor, the Diktat's government flickered. The resentful Corellian population protested more and more vehemently<ref name="CTD" /> and the regime gradually lost power to the [[Sacorrian Triad|Triad]] of [[Sacorria]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the Diktat dissolved the prestigious [[Corellian Security Force]] and created to the [[Public Safety Service]],<ref name="XW:WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> an Imperialistic security force and political police tasked with protecting the regime.<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> However, as early as [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="XW:SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref> the Diktat's regime fell apart. As the population revolted, the Corellian armed forces<ref name="AaS" /> and security forces eventually stopped to protect the government.<ref name="AaC" /> Daclif Gallamby and his supporters soon grabbed half the credits in the state treasury and fled the Corellian system. Due to the sudden disappearance of the Diktat, the regime collapsed.<ref name="AaS" /> The Corellian administration remained in disarray until the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] gained control of the Corellian sector and appointed a Governor-General to rule the planet Corellia and the sector.<ref name="CTD" />

In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], during the [[Corellian Crisis]], the Corellian separatists of the [[Human League]] assassinated New Republic Governor-General [[Micamberlecto]] and seized control of Corellia. Their leader, [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]], proclaimed himself the new Diktat of Corellia with the objective to re-establish the previous regime.<ref name="AaS" /> However, Sal-Solo's reign was short-lived since the New Republic restored its authority over the Corellian system at the end of the Corellian Crisis.<ref name="CTD" />

About two decades later, years after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the New Republic abolished the position of Governor-General of the Corellian sector, thereby allowing the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] to restore a democratic political regime on Corellia based on earlier Corellian institutions: the [[Five Worlds]].<ref name="Betrayal" />
